messages:
jamie: Quick roll-call — aiming to cut v1.8.2 in ~2h. Primary checklist: version bump, changelog, QA smoke, security quick-scan, branch clearance. If you own any of those pls ack and ETA. I'll paste minimal commands below.

marta: Ack — I'll update CHANGELOG.md and docs. Will open PR for the bump shortly. ETA ~20m.

liam: I'll handle the version bump and tag. Plan: branch release/v1.8.2 from main, bump package.json and go.mod, then push. ETA ~25–30m.

ana-qa: @jamie @marta I can run smoke suite once PR is merged. Any known flaky tests to skip? list them here and I'll skip if needed.

nk-security: I'll run a quick SAST/secret-scan once PR is up. If any high sev findings, we stop the cut. ETA ~40m after PR.

deploy-bot: build-bot: CI pipeline triggered for branch release/v1.8.2 — 3/4 jobs passed, integration pending.

jamie: Commands I'm planning to run for the bump (copy/paste):
```bash
git checkout -b release/v1.8.2 main
# update package version and changelog
git add package.json CHANGELOG.md
git commit -m "chore(release): v1.8.2

- fix: improve cache routing for small payloads
- perf: reduce kv-cache churn
- docs: changelog entry
"
git push origin release/v1.8.2
gh pr create --base main --head release/v1.8.2 --title "chore: release v1.8.2" --body "Release PR for v1.8.2"
```

marta: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/PR/4123 — added changelog entry and small docs note. cc @liam for the tag and @nk-security for scan.

liam: Reviewing now. Left 1 nit about commit message formatting, will push fix and approve.

nk-security: SAST quick-scan started. No new deps in go.mod, scanned third_party libs — will report within ~35m.

ana-qa: Started smoke run after merge. Hit a failure in tokenization-smoke-01 (flaky). Re-rerunning with different seed.

jamie: If QA block > 1h we fallback to postponing cut. Keep us updated. Also ensure changelog mentions impact on routing cache so ops knows.

ana-qa: Re-run green: smoke suite passed (all critical tests). Marking QA as ✅ — logs: https://ci.redwood/243210/logs/smoke-243210.

nk-security: SAST complete — no high/critical findings, two minors (license header missing in vendor/something). Filing a follow-up ticket: https://issues.redwood/ISSUE-789. Not blocking release.

deploy-bot: canary-bot: Canary deploy scheduled at 30m post-cut; initial traffic 5% to release/v1.8.2. Health checks enabled.

jamie: Great work — thanks. I'll cut the release at 18:00 UTC unless anyone objects. If anything else pops up, flag here.

marta: small follow-up: added link to docs PR in release notes.

liam: Tag pushed: v1.8.2 — https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/tag/v1.8.2.

jamie: Final: release cut confirmed. Thanks everyone :)
